scope: Closed evidence-selection retry. Menus are authored on this docket. The same source-owner reply serves both arms, and public wording is fixed. There are no new peer turns.

named-independent.record:
Adoption: On 31 October 2024, draft S/2024/796 became resolution 2756 (2024) by 12–0–2. Algeria did not participate [MAIN].
Amendments: Algeria’s S/2024/797 on nine years without an OHCHR visit failed 6–0–9. S/2024/798, to consider expanding MINURSO for rights monitoring, failed 5–0–10 [AMEND].
Algeria: Algeria argued for a human-rights monitoring component in MINURSO [DZ-DRAFT]. Algeria said the penholder disregarded its views, explaining its non-participation [DZ-DRAFT].
Switzerland: Switzerland supported S/2024/797 [CH-DRAFT]. Switzerland abstained on S/2024/798 to ensure MINURSO continuity [CH-DRAFT].
Authority: The Council extended MINURSO until 31 October 2025 and urged cooperation including OHCHR visits. It did not add the monitoring functions [TEXT].
